name: Vegetable Quinoa Pulao
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: ½ cup (90 g) quinoa, rinsed well
1 bay leaf, 2 cloves, 1 small cinnamon stick and ½ tsp cumin seeds
¼ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp garam masala
steps: Heat the oil and crackle the whole spices. Add the onion and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the ginger-garlic paste, vegetables, turmeric and garam masala and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the quinoa, water and salt. Bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on low for 12 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Rest for 5 minutes, fluff, and finish with lemon juice and coriander.
note: Quinoa is a complete protein; rinsing removes its natural bitter coating.
